tools.name: pawoon_get_company
tools.description: Return the company profile, business information and notification settings. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /companies/me.

tools.name: pawoon_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the company payment methods, including manual and integrated ones (GoPay, OVO, DANA). Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /company-payment-methods.

tools.name: pawoon_list_outlets
tools.description: List the outlets with their address, tax and service settings. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /outlets.

tools.name: pawoon_list_devices
tools.description: List the registered POS devices. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /devices.

tools.name: pawoon_list_users
tools.description: List the staff accounts of the company. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /users.

tools.name: pawoon_list_taxes
tools.description: List the tax rules of the company. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /taxes.

tools.name: pawoon_list_services
tools.description: List the service charge rules of the company. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /services.

tools.name: pawoon_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers (name, contact, member id). Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /customers.

tools.name: pawoon_get_customer
tools.description: Return one customer by id. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: pawoon_list_products
tools.description: List the products of an outlet with price, category and stock unit. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /products?outlet_id.

tools.name: pawoon_get_product
tools.description: Return one product with its details. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: pawoon_list_product_categories
tools.description: List the product categories. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /products/categories.

tools.name: pawoon_list_product_variants
tools.description: List the variants of one product (size, colour, and so on). Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /products/{product_id}/variants.

tools.name: pawoon_list_modifier_groups
tools.description: List the modifier groups attached to one product. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /products/{product_id}/modifier-groups.

tools.name: pawoon_list_modifiers
tools.description: List the modifiers of one modifier group. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /modifier-groups/{modifier_group_id}/modifiers.

tools.name: pawoon_list_stock_cards
tools.description: Return the stock report per product: beginning stock, stock in, stock out and sales. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /stock-cards.

tools.name: pawoon_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List the purchase orders. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /purchase-orders.

tools.name: pawoon_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers, with paging. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /suppliers.

tools.name: pawoon_list_promos
tools.description: List the promos of an outlet (promo type, dates), with paging. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /outlets/{outlet_id}/promos.

tools.name: pawoon_get_promo
tools.description: Return the detail of one promo. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /promos/{promo_id}/detail.

tools.name: pawoon_list_vouchers
tools.description: List the vouchers of an outlet (code, type, amount, validity, quota, used). Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /vouchers?outlet_id.

tools.name: pawoon_list_transactions
tools.description: List sales transactions (receipt code, outlet, cashier, totals). The vendor documents no filters for this list. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /transactions.

tools.name: pawoon_get_transaction_payments
tools.description: List the payments of one transaction. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /transactions/{transaction_id}/payments.

tools.name: pawoon_get_transaction_items
tools.description: List the items of one transaction, with their modifiers. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /transactions/{transaction_id}/items?include=modifiers.

tools.name: pawoon_get_sales_summary
tools.description: Return gross sales, discounts, refunds, net sales, taxes, services and transaction count. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /reports/summary.

tools.name: pawoon_get_product_sales_report
tools.description: Return sales per product, category and SKU. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /reports/product-sales.

tools.name: pawoon_get_payment_method_report
tools.description: Return the number and amount of payments per payment method. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /reports/payment-methods.

tools.name: pawoon_get_promo_report
tools.description: Return the use and amount of each promo. Pawoon OpenAPI: GET /reports/promos.
